summary: This Form 8-K filed by Golub Capital Private Credit Fund (the Fund) discloses a routine monthly distribution declaration and a business update. The filing confirms previously declared regular distributions for Class I and Class S shares for June 2026, payable on July 30, 2026, to record holders as of June 30, 2026. It also provides portfolio commentary as of May 31, 2026, listing investment composition, leverage ratios, NAV per share, and industry breakdown. There is no transactional event, shareholder action, or structural change. The filing is purely informational under Items 7.01 and 8.01, reflecting standard reporting for a business development company.
